sourceScope: All 11 published transcript paragraphs, 45 phrase voice windows and six long-turn tails. Acoustic checks separate Customer from the compatible Narration/agent group; Narrator versus Travel agent are content-derived roles, not a claim of distinct physical voices. Both three-way model calibrations are retained in the audit. Four zero-duration or missing-word cases retain a whole source phrase cue instead of invented internal timing. Compound names/prices recovered from the cached full recognition and corroborated by cropped recognition. Source spelling self-hatering retained; no verbatim wording audit.

voiceComparison.modelTrainingLanguage: Chinese; recording-specific controls used for English audio
voiceComparison.roleLimitation: Both ERes2Net and English WeSpeaker fail leave-one-out calibration separating narrator from travel agent. Those are text roles, not a claim of distinct physical voices. Acoustic verification separates the customer from the compatible narration/agent group.

renderedGroups.speaker: Narrator
renderedGroups.text: Test 2 This is the IELTS listening test. You will hear a number of different recordings, and you will have to answer questions on what you hear. There will be time for you to read the instructions and questions, and you will have a chance to check your work. All the recordings will be played once only. The test is in four parts. At the end of the test, you will be given 10 minutes to transfer your answers

renderedGroups.speaker: Narrator
renderedGroups.text: to the answer sheet. Now turn to part one. Part one. You will hear a customer asking a travel agent for information about some trips. First, you have some time to look at questions one to six. Now listen carefully and answer questions one to six.

renderedGroups.speaker: Customer
renderedGroups.text: Good afternoon.

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: Good afternoon, Atlanta Travel Agency. May I help you?

renderedGroups.speaker: Customer
renderedGroups.text: I saw your advert in the newspaper this morning and decided to come over for more detailed information about some trips that you currently offer.

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: What kind of trips do you have in mind?

renderedGroups.speaker: Customer
renderedGroups.text: Well, I enjoy surfing very much and want to get tanned, but all my friends suggest either mountain climbing or biking.

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: We currently offer all the three types. Even though biking is the most popular type of holiday, it doesn't work for everyone. I think you should follow your heart.

renderedGroups.speaker: Customer
renderedGroups.text: Right. What are my options for accommodation then?

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: For this type of holiday, you can choose to stay in a hotel or a self-hatering apartment.

renderedGroups.speaker: Customer
renderedGroups.text: Can you introduce the hotel package first?

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: Sure. The price for our hotel package is quite reasonable compared with that of your own reservation.

renderedGroups.speaker: Customer
renderedGroups.text: What does the price include?

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: It covers the beachside hotel and free breakfast.

renderedGroups.speaker: Customer
renderedGroups.text: Good. Does the hotel have any recreational facilities?

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: Oh, rest assured. The hotel is fully equipped with a pool, a nightclub and a gym. Guests can enjoy a vibrant nightlife during their stay at the hotel.

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: Five-star ratings are common for the hotel's satisfying service.

renderedGroups.speaker: Customer
renderedGroups.text: So how much does it cost?

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: Well, it was originally €360 for an adult, but we are now offering a Labor Day promotion. You can get a discount of 12.5%, so that's €315 for now. A really good deal.

renderedGroups.speaker: Customer
renderedGroups.text: Right. What about the self-catering apartment?

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: Oh, that'll be even cheaper.

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: But you have to stay in a shared room with other guests. Each room has six bunk beds with lockers.

renderedGroups.speaker: Customer
renderedGroups.text: OK. I think the hotel is much better. Getting a good night's sleep is critical for a relaxing holiday. I can't stand sharing a room with someone who snores all night long.

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: Can't agree more.

renderedGroups.speaker: Customer
renderedGroups.text: What about the surfing equipment rental? I don't want to bring my own surfboard.

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: You can hire a surfboard by the hour, day or week. Just book it in advance and it will be delivered to the hotel or even directly to the beach.

renderedGroups.speaker: Customer
renderedGroups.text: How much does it cost?

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: It costs 15 euros for a day, but for a week's rental, it's just 75 euros. The surf station also provides surf lessons if you're interested.

renderedGroups.speaker: Customer
renderedGroups.text: That's good to know.

renderedGroups.speaker: Narrator
renderedGroups.text: Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions 7 to 10. Now listen and answer questions 7 to 10.

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: Oh, there's one more thing you should know.

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: Just in case of an accident during your trip, we recommend each customer to have the correct travel cover in place before leaving home.

renderedGroups.speaker: Customer
renderedGroups.text: Please tell me about it.

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: Well, we mainly offer two types of insurance. The first one is basic coverage. It costs 30 euros.

renderedGroups.speaker: Customer
renderedGroups.text: What does it include?

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: It covers medical treatment during your trip and things like missing your flight, flight delays and cancellations. But you know, extreme sports can be quite dangerous and therefore injuries during these activities are excluded.

renderedGroups.speaker: Customer
renderedGroups.text: Then how about the other one?

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: The second one is called Premier Cover. It is more expensive at €42.50, but we highly recommend this one for regular surfers. If you receive an injury or hurt anyone else while participating in extreme sports like surfing, you are fully covered.

renderedGroups.speaker: Customer
renderedGroups.text: I see. I think I'll go with the Premier Cover.

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: When your flight gets in, there will be a minivan to pick you up at the airport and take you to the hotel.

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: but you'll have to get to London Airport yourself.

renderedGroups.speaker: Customer
renderedGroups.text: It's alright, I'll just take the airport shuttle.

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: Actually, I personally suggest you take a taxi. It's much cheaper than other types of transport, including the airport shuttle.

renderedGroups.speaker: Customer
renderedGroups.text: Thanks for the tip. I think I'll book a trip for next weekend.

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: Okay, how would you like to pay?

renderedGroups.speaker: Customer
renderedGroups.text: Do you accept credit cards?

renderedGroups.speaker: Travel agent
renderedGroups.text: Yes we do, but there will be a slight charge on that. If you pay by check, there's no extra fee.

renderedGroups.speaker: Customer
renderedGroups.text: Great, I'll write you a check then.

renderedGroups.speaker: Narrator
renderedGroups.text: That is the end of part one.

renderedGroups.speaker: Narrator
renderedGroups.text: You now have one minute to check your answers to part one.
